scope: Investigation/proposal and isolated diagnostic runners only; no production simulation/presentation policy changes.

methods.runtime: Fresh seed-2026 native city; real game/Worker/IndexedDB; normal traffic, pedestrians, activation and renderer. Driver setup explicitly boards/stops an existing car; compact variant replaces one car using production factory.
methods.sampling: 4 s warmup/8 s client frame window. Authority recorder surrounds native input setup and client read, so its tick window is slightly longer. Top-level phase timings inclusive; percentiles cannot be summed. Optional population census outside measured tick every 30 ticks adds overhead. Deep/CPU lanes excluded from shallow timing comparisons.
methods.selection: Gateway at (300,519); core at (300,479). Native horizontal-car choice depends on spawn/load progress and chooses by heading then X distance; it can board a different road/neighborhood. Actual lane/pose/model, counts and views retained. No fixed-population matched speedup claim.
methods.renderer: Phone dpr 2.625, desktop dpr 1, CSS viewport 411x789. GPU/mesh mode enabled but native selected vehicles use sprite fallbacks; only explicit desktop compact variant establishes actual GLB draw coverage. No cool-phone 0.05 or mesh-city acceptance.
methods.terrainReads: Final census distinct sets reset each server tick and are keyed by phase and traffic car; repeated scalar road/height reads inside one car/tick are counted, not surviving allocations or predicted savings.
methods.timeline: rAF callback intervals only; no GPU process/display-present trace. Raw traces stay local. Durations and slow-frame/tick overlaps retained; temporal overlap is not causation.
methods.pilots: Discovery/pilot rows retained but excluded from clean pacing/capacity conclusions. The initial sample established lastFrame before an awaited diagnostics reset and therefore includes a spurious first long interval. Final helper aligns to rAF after reset. Desktop pilot and first phone pilot overlap briefly; no before/after gain lane.
methods.distributions: Histogram entries are [milliseconds, count], rounded to 1e-6 ms; raw reports remain local with SHA256. Slow-frame temporal overlaps retain relative offsets.

proposals: Per-car synchronous traffic lookahead road/height reuse; retain live obstacle/junction checks and next-car/next-tick terrain freshness; measure before shipping.
Local swept collision candidates for player driving on both authority and predictor, keeping roof-passenger support/headroom dependencies.
Wide-camera snapshot/interest profiling; any reduced NPC publication must retain player input acknowledgements, edits and entry/exit freshness.
Cool-phone wide-view main/GPU trace with actual compact mesh to separate rendering/presentation and thermal limits; preserve native touch.
